item.gsm.upgrade.tooltip.crafting:
Adds a crafting tab to the storage menu.
Craft right next to your storage.
item.gsm.upgrade.tooltip.capacity_1:
+4 stacks of room in every module.
Can't be taken out while the system holds
more than would fit without it.
item.gsm.upgrade.tooltip.capacity_2:
+9 stacks of room in every module.
Can't be taken out while the system holds
more than would fit without it.
item.gsm.upgrade.tooltip.whole_system: Goes in an upgrade slot; works for the whole system.
gui.gsm.auto_fill.tooltip: After each craft, refill the crafting grid from storage with the same items, so you can keep crafting. Shift-click the result to craft as many as storage allows. Applies to everyone using this system.
gui.gsm.builtin_rules: This built-in tab has no rules.
gui.gsm.sorting.tooltip: When sorting is off, no new items enter this tab. Items already in it stay.
gui.gsm.rotate_disguise: Turn disguise (only for blocks that face a direction, like logs)
gui.gsm.sort.name: name
gui.gsm.disguise.hint:
Put a full, solid block here to make
the module you opened look like it.
Take it out to remove the disguise.
gui.gsm.help:
Right-click a tab while holding an item: add that item to the tab
Press Delete over an item: take it out of this tab

The slot beside your inventory disguises the module you opened.

Search only looks in the selected tab.
Scroll over the tabs to see more.
